 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Minister of Justice and Attorney General of Canada, I recused myself on May 16, 2024, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the appointment of a Judge of the Ontario Superior Court of Justice in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend, Ms. Linda Shin. 
 On March 19, 2024, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from discussions and decisions concerning the re-appointment of Mr. Darren Thorne to be a full-time member of the Immigration and Refugee Board in order to avoid any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend.
